feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 9 September 2026 4:14am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

NW 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, backing W or NW 2 to 4 in the afternoon, backing S or SW 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather)##

Isolated showers at first, then fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, possibly moderate in showers at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 16°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds for a time.


##Wind)##

S or SW 4 or 5, quickly backing S 5 to 7, veering SW 3 or 4 in the evening, veering W 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, quickly building mainly moderate and occasionally rough in the west. Becoming mainly slight later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first, then occasional rain or drizzle quickly arriving, then clearing in the evening.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Friday, 11 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

W 4 or 5, soon backing W or SW 3 or 4, backing S 5 to 7 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, building mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Fair at first then rain overnight into Saturday.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Saturday, 12 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

S 6 or 7, soon veering S or SW 5 or 6, veering W or SW 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain or drizzle becoming isolated later.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Sunday, 13 September 2026##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

W or SW 4 or 5, soon becoming NW 2 to 4, then variable later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Mainly good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 17°C
